header.name: Deep Learning
header.description: Recent advances in machine learning and specifically deep learning techniques have made it a popular and often a default option in many problem domains. The objective of this course is to introduce students through some of the latest techniques in deep learning. The focus of the course will be hands on and the students should be able to design intelligent deep learning systems for solving the problems in the area of their interests.
prerequisites_mandatory: Machine Learning or Introduction to Machine Learning

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Explain and critically interpret the mathematical foundations, optimization techniques, and architectural principles underlying modern deep learning models.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Apply advanced deep learning frameworks and methodologies to implement, train, and optimize models for diverse machine learning tasks.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to design and implement their own deep learning models for the problem of their choice

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Analyze and evaluate the performance, scalability, and limitations of different deep learning architectures by comparing design choices, optimization strategies, and experimental results.

lecture_topics: McCullogh-Pitts, Hebbian Law, Adaline, Madaline, Perceptron
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Separating Hyperplanes, Loss and Risk, Over/Under fitting, Function approximation
Universal Approximation Theorem: Width vs Depth, Rate of Convergence
Neural Net Training: Overview of Gradient Descent & Back-propagation Algorithm
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Implementation: Backprop, Data Loaders, Custom layers, Training/Inference Pipelines

lecture_topics: Receptive field, Padding, Stride, and Dilation
CNNs: Group/Channel Splitting, Depthwise & Depthseprable Convolutions
Model Visualization: loss landscape, weights, activations, senstivity maps, saliency maps & layer embeddings
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Implemention Popular CNN architectures e.g., AlexNet, VGGNet and an application

lecture_topics: Regularization: Bias-Variance Trade-off, Double Descend, Grokking, Forward/Backward Pass Penelties, L1/L2/DropOut and variants,
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Tutorial on advance CNN architectures e.g., DensNets, ResNets, ResNext, Network-in-Network, Inception

lecture_topics: Batchsize, Stepsize, Learning Rate Scheduler, Custom Callbacks
Numerical Stability and Parameter Initialization, Hyper-parameter Optimization
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Tutorial on AutoML via Optuna & Hyperopt

lecture_topics: Sequence Modelling: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Long Short Term Memory models (LSTMs), Gated Recurrent Units (GRU), Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) & Beam Search
Introduction to Transformers: Embeddings, Self/multi-head Attention, Positional Encoding, Encoder-Decoder models

weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Tutorial on Implementing Multi-GPU Data/Model Parallel Training Pipelines

lecture_topics: Introduction to Graph Neural Networks and Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN)
Ethics, Safety, Bias & Robustness in DL Models
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Implement a GCN with PyTorch Geometric

lecture_topics: Model Compression: Structural vs Non-structural Compression
Pruning, Quantization, Knowledge Distillation, Low-Rank Adaptation, Neural Architecture Search and Transfer Learning
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Tutorial on Backends & Frameworks for Deployment. Implement a model compression techniques for a DNN

resources.title: Deep Learning by Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, and Aaron, The MIT Press [https://www.deeplearningbook.org]
Deep Learning: Foundations and Concepts Book by Christopher Bishop and Hugh Bishop, Springer [https://www.bishopbook.com]
Understanding Deep Learning by Simon J.D. Prince, The MIT Press [http://udlbook.com]
